source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: The text of a signed-out landing page, pasted.

In the Apple app the sign-in-wall guard exists only on the capture path: pasted wall text is saved as a session. The web app applies the same test to pasted text and answers `sign_in_suspected`; the user may then choose to import anyway.
